subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should configured TTS providers remain best-effort with automatic cross-provider fallback, or should selected-provider speech be sticky/fail-closed when the chosen provider fails or is skipped?
rationale: Current docs and tests preserve fallback, while this issue asks for provider stickiness; changing either default affects existing user setups and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep fallback default and improve warning UX
options.body: Preserve compatibility while making fallback activation and provider mismatch more visible in user-facing status or warnings.

options.title: Make selected provider sticky by default
options.body: Fail closed when the selected provider cannot deliver audio, accepting a compatibility change for users who currently rely on fallback audio.

options.title: Add explicit strict/no-fallback policy
options.body: Keep current fallback behavior by default but add an operator-controlled strict mode for voice identity workflows.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback default and improve warning UX
recommendation.body: Preserve compatibility while making fallback activation and provider mismatch more visible in user-facing status or warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh authored the partial fallback diagnostics fixes and explicitly identified provider stickiness as remaining scope.
